title: Number of Different Integers in a String
goal: Count distinct integers embedded in a mixed lowercase-and-digit string.
strategy: Read maximal digit runs and remove leading zeros. Compare normalized text rather than numeric conversion so arbitrarily long integers retain their exact identity.
